title: A body in a static field that is not sharp: mixture over sectors, fall, clock rate and the relation (4.24)

Drift acceleration of the mean position label
Mean over the sectors of the clock advance

Relative first-order difference of the mean rates at x = 0
Gradient vector of the level k in the sector

open_issues: The cross part of the first-order velocity in the class S_a, (9.18), is an order estimate O(λ^(1/2)) by stationary phase; a bound with explicit constants of the kind of (4.10) was not derived.
The constants R_i(g) of (9.7) are taken from the boundedness stated in (4.7); their explicit form is not quoted, so the joint limit λ → ∞, δp → 0 of (9.8) is stated only in the order given.
The within-sector term of the total variance (9.2) at second order in the gradients is outside the scope; only the term over the sectors is determined.

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions of (9.6), (9.8), (9.14) and (9.20) in label units with costs of dimension 1/λ
Sharp field: all variances and covariances over the sectors vanish and (9.3), (9.6), (9.13), (9.15), (9.20) reduce to the results for one sector
Two sectors with equal weights, control (9.11): direct mean and variance of the sector drift accelerations agree with (9.6), (9.8), and (9.15) holds while (4.24) fails in each sector
